reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: handleConsent is actively called from consent-form.tsx:L53 (non-test). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in scope file; entry point is user-controlled FormData (untrusted). Gate 3: src/app/oauth/ is explicitly in scope. An attacker can trigger this via the consent form by tampering the hidden redirect_uri field (e.g., via browser devtools) to an attacker-controlled URI before submission; handleConsent (actions.ts:L86) stores the tampered URI in the authorization code DB record and redirects the code there (L106-109), after which the attacker calls /oauth/token with the same URI to exchange the code for a valid access token. No severity cap applies (no client_diversity or severity_classification thresholds defined); HIGH maintained.
